newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.

text.p: Assets of the nation's 664 retail money market mutual funds rose $2.97 billion to $593.43 billion in the week ended Sept. 11, the Investment Company Institute said Thursday.

The industry trade group said assets of the 407 taxable money market funds in the retail category rose $2.55 billion to $483.27 billion, while assets of the 257 tax-exempt funds rose $419.3 million to $110.16 billion.

The trade group said assets of the 304 institutional money market funds rose $4.83 billion to $268.11 billion. Of these, the 242 taxable money market fund assets grew $5.07 billion to $238.60 billion, and assets of the 62 tax exempt funds fell $235.4 million to $29.51 billion.
Money market mutual fund assets stood at $861.54 billion in the week. Assets for the week ended Sept. 4 were revised to $853.74 billion from $853.74 billion.
